workloads: Fixed question/document authorization objects; independent stateless task calls grouped by session identity, not answer-fed conversational history. Registered tenant identities are not concurrent GPU requests.

calibration.task_source_balance: 20 frames per one of four development sources
calibration.source_order: seeded source order, within-source20 unique tenant/turn points
calibration.backend_TTFT_used_for_SLO: send-to-first-content in Raw backlog, not its all-arrive-zero queue latency
calibration.rate: 80 / direct measured Raw backlog epoch wall, including common setup/final drain

formal_marks.locality: two32-request blocks per template: turns1-4 then5-8 across8tenants. Source order reshuffled by frozen repeat seed; all marks retained.
formal_marks.reason: Controlled authorized-template locality is an explicit operating condition. This is not a production popularity trace or a claim about uniformly interleaved arbitrarily large working sets.

arrivals: Marked Poisson. Same precomputed unit exponential gaps and source/tenant/turn marks for paired arms; two Qwen rates scale the same gaps. Repeat seeds frozen before formal outcomes.

SLO.primary: successful and planned-arrival-to-first-content TTFT <= frozen TTFT SLO
SLO.secondary: primary plus planned-arrival-to-completion <= frozen E2E SLO
SLO.formula: max(1500, ceil(1.5*Raw-only backend p95/500)*500)ms, separately for TTFT/E2E

complete_clock: Entry epoch before source prep/registration. Global planned arrivals are not shifted by registration barrier. Client admission concurrency2, same native GPU max_num_seqs2. Includes failures, controller, canary, verification, binding and drain; startup/import outside client epoch reported separately.
cache: Same authorized template cache group in all businesses and both granularity arms; controller-private canary group identical policy for Session/Template. Existing certified-prefix reads allowed for BOTH verifiers.
metrics: Actual Native initial prefix hit and prompt-hit new-prefill; never convert token counts/RPC time into GPU kernel time. Full serving metric plus source/repeat granularity; original F8 kept independent.
